s: Igloo Products develops and manufacture coolers ice chests and insulated cooler bags.

This year we are celebrating 70 years as the worldwide leader in coolers and hydration systems. We offer quality, durable, and innovative products from our new Trailmate Liddup and Marine models, to our Sportsman Waterproof Backpacks.

Born from a modest metalworking shop back in 1947, Igloo has been instrumental in redefining how we live, work and play. What began with bringing clean water to the worksite quickly moved into super-functional, best in class ice chests. Igloo products made the family outdoor recreation movement of the 20th century possible.
